label: Bible Study
prompt: Rejoiceth not in _____, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verse: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
note: Love doesn't enjoy anyone's downfall — it celebrates what's true.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Finally, my brethren, be _____ in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verse: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
note: Just before the armour of God comes the pep talk: be strong in the Lord — in His might, not yours.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the _____.
verse: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
note: An east wind all day and all night, and by morning the locusts arrived — then a west wind blew them into the Red Sea.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the word is very _____ unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verse: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
note: God's word isn't up in heaven or across the sea — Paul quotes this in Romans 10.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth _____.
verse: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
note: The watchman recognized Jehu by his driving: 'he driveth furiously' — Scripture's most famous chariot speeder.
